$comment: CI-failure demo against real GitHub through the test-only fault proxy on loopback (hence allow_private_network, honoured only in isolated test mode). The repository must be an owner-approved, dedicated demo repository, set with VAP_GITHUB_REPOSITORY. Credentials are a GitHub App installation scoped to that repository; set VAP_GITHUB_AUTHOR_LOGIN to the app's bot login (<app-slug>[bot]) so only its own issues can satisfy a lookup; the three variables are populated from a secret store at run time and never written to files.
